question: To what kind of person, endowed with all states and resolved in mind, must this teaching be given?
premises: A teaching is fit to be given.
It is to be given to one endowed with all states.
It is to be given to one of resolved mind.
inference: This teaching is to be given to one endowed with all states and of resolved mind.
uncertainties: Which teaching is meant not restated here
plain_english: This is to be given to one endowed with all states and of resolved mind.
